name: wrap-buttons
description: After a wrap-up reply, shows buttons to /clear and carry the handoff's next step into a fresh session.

marker.title: Wrap-up marker
marker.description: Text in a reply that means the wrap-up is done; the reply from it on is the handoff carried over.

nextLabel.title: Next step label
nextLabel.description: Label of the handoff line holding the next step, e.g. 'Next Up' in '- **Next Up**: ...'.
